steps.text: Talk to Arhein on the Catherby docks.
Talk to Councillor Catherine in the council office in north-east Catherby.
If needed, search the nearby cabinet for charcoal.
With charcoal in your inventory, fill in form cr-4p, selecting the first option for every question.
Talk to Councillor Catherine again to return the form.

chat: 2. I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.

steps.text: Talk to Harry in the fishing shop in the easternmost building in Catherby.
He will sell you the mayoral fishbowl and tiny net for 50 coins.
Use the tiny net on either aquarium in the shop to catch the Mayor of Catherby.
Talk to Arhein again to have him place a mayoral chain on the mayor.
Talk to Councillor Catherine and select the first option for every question again.
Use form 7r4-5h on the Mayor of Catherby, then talk to Catherine to return the signed form.
Talk to Arhein again to receive the current duck.
Board your boat at the Catherby docks and sail east to the ripple immediately west of the Obelisk of Water.
While your boat is on top of the ripple, click the current duck in your inventory to place it in the water.
Follow the duck until it reaches the shore near Holgart, then collect it.
